title: Release docs test allows a duplicated no-change line
lead: `CurrentChangesLabelProblems` checks `none > 0` and never `none == 1`, so two identical "No API or breaking changes in X (library)." lines pass. Reject a duplicate, with a theory case and a mutation check.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: 1. Add the rejected case, watch it fail; 2. change the check; 3. mutation-check.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Build, test and format pass; `slicer check` passes.
